fullContentHtml:
Bank of Baroda SO Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 1100 Wealth Executive, Credit Analyst Posts - Complete Details

Bank of Baroda has announced the Recruitment 2026 notification for 1100 vacancies, including Wealth Executive, Credit Analyst posts. Eligible candidates can submit their offline applications from 04 September 2026 to 24 September 2026 Interested candidates can apply online through the official website, bankofbaroda.bank.in.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 04.09.2026
  • Application Last Date : 24.09.2026
  • Eligibility Cut-Off Date : 01.09.2026
  • Online Registration Start Date : 04.09.2026
  • Last Date for Submission of Application & Payment of Fees : 24.09.2026
  • Eligibility Cut-Off Date : 01.09.2026
  • Online Test Date : Not specified in the notification (to be advised separately)

Application Fee

  • Posts : Wealth Executive, Credit Analyst – C&IC
  • Application Start Date : 04.09.2026
  • Application Last Date : 24.09.2026
  • Online Registration Start Date : 04.09.2026
  • Last Date for Submission of Application & Payment of Fees : 24.09.2026
  • Online Test Date : Not specified in the notification (to be advised separately)
  • Post : Qualification
  • Credit Analyst – C&IC : Graduation in any discipline AND Chartered Accountant.
  • Post : Minimum Age
  • Credit Analyst – C&IC : 21 years
  • Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe : 5 years
  • Ex-Servicemen / Commissioned Officers (incl. ECOs/SSCOs, min. 5 years military service) : Gen/EWS – 5 years, OBC – 8 years, SC/ST – 10 years
  • Credit Analyst – C&IC : 15
  • Grade / Scale : Pay Scale
  • MMG/S-II (Credit Analyst – C&IC) : 64820–2340/1–67160–2680/10–93960
  • General, EWS & OBC : Rs. 850/- + Payment Gateway Charges
  • SC, ST, PWBD, ESM (Ex-Servicemen) & Women : Rs. 175/- + Payment Gateway Charges

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
